products.name: Aval Matta (Milky)
products.desc:
Enjoy the nostalgic taste of traditional Kerala Matta Rice Aval! Made from Kerala's traditional red rice, perfect for a wholesome breakfast or evening snack.

Ready to eat! Enjoy with banana, grated coconut, sugar or jaggery milk. A timeless Kerala favourite for every home.

products.name: Aval Mixture, Sweet (Milky)
products.desc:
Enjoy the delicious taste of traditional Kerala style sweet aval mixture! Made with quality matta rice aval, crunchy peanuts, curry leaves and traditional ingredients, offering a delightful sweet and crunchy flavour.

A ready-to-eat snack, perfect for tea time, family gatherings and everyday munching. A nostalgic Kerala favourite for all ages!

Traditional taste. Sweet & crunchy delight!

products.name: Chammanthi Podi (Salsha)
products.desc:
Enjoy the nostalgic taste of traditional Kerala homemade chammanthi! Prepared with quality dry prawns, roasted dry chillies and salt, offering a delicious, spicy and savoury flavour.

Ready to eat! Simply mix 1–2 spoons with a little coconut oil and enjoy with rice.

A taste of Kerala's tradition in every spoon!

products.name: Nadan Valan Puli, Seedless (Salsha)
products.desc:
Enjoy the authentic tangy taste of traditional Kerala Nadan Valan Puli. Premium quality, seedless tamarind with salt already added, making it convenient and easy to use.

Perfect for Kerala fish curry, sambhar, rasam, pulinji, chammanthi and other traditional dishes. Adds a delicious tangy flavour, enhances taste and balances the richness of spices.

Pure traditional taste, made convenient for every Kerala kitchen!

products.name: Dry Prawns, Unakka Chemmeen (Salsha)
products.desc:
Enjoy the authentic taste of traditional Kerala dry prawns! Made from original Kerala prawns, carefully dried, cleaned and selected for good quality and rich flavour.

Perfect for unakka chemmeen curry, chammanthi, coconut based dishes and traditional Kerala recipes.

Rich in protein and natural seafood flavour, dry prawns add a distinctive aroma and nostalgic homemade taste to every meal. Conveniently packed for freshness, easy storage and everyday kitchen use.

Bring back the nostalgic taste of Kerala!

products.name: Nadan Coconut Oil (Salsha)
products.desc:
Bring home the authentic taste and natural goodness of traditional Kerala coconut oil. With its rich aroma and flavour, Salsha is perfect for everyday cooking, frying, fish curry, traditional Kerala dishes and more.

A timeless choice for every Kerala kitchen, with quality you can trust!

products.name: Nadan Ghee (Milky)
products.desc:
Experience the rich aroma and authentic taste of traditional Kerala style Nadan Ghee from Milky.

Crafted with a focus on quality, it brings richness and flavour to everyday meals and special occasions.

Perfect for rice, biryani, dosa, idli, chapati, puttu, curries, traditional Kerala sweets, payasam and desserts.

Bring home the taste of tradition!

products.name: Bazar Kitchen Combo
products.desc:
Your daily kitchen needs, all in one place!

Bring home the authentic flavours of Kerala with our carefully selected combination of everyday kitchen essentials from Milky and Salsha.

This combo brings together seven traditional favourites:
1. Coconut Oil – 1 Litre
2. Nadan Ghee – 500 ml
3. Seedless Nadan Valan Puli – 500 gr
4. Dry Prawns – 100 gr
5. Chammanthi Podi – 100 gr
6. Aval Mixture (Sweet) – 250 gr
7. Matta Aval – 350 gr

One combo. A taste of Kerala every day!
